scope_note: Evaluation tooling only. No algorithm, config, front-end or replay is touched. Every command below is offline: synthetic fixtures, or recomputation over EXISTING artifacts.

dependencies.open3d: 0.19.0 present; needed ONLY for binary_compressed PCD input and the optional --icp conditional diagnostic; the metric itself is pure numpy/scipy

steps.name: full synthetic + protocol + parity modules
steps.expected: 58 passed, 0 failed (3 modules: test_map_accuracy_eval.py 34, test_gt_time_assoc_eval.py 12, test_cross_check_parity.py 12); ~100 s wall. HISTORIC: the pre-2026-09-30 revisions of these modules collected 49/50/54 tests; the counts changed because the R38 regression cases were added (and because the test modules had drifted from the stale manifest). See evaluator_hashes.json -> historic_recorded_hashes for the hashes the historic verification ran against.
covers: R01 raw-value headline + truncation cannot promote a PASS
R02 whole-map membership, full-cloud support search, drifted-out vs no-reference
R03 transform admissibility by sample/run/time-index provenance (spatially overlapping independent runs ACCEPTED, same-run fitting REJECTED, missing provenance REJECTED)
R06 3-D coincidence definition (tangential slip is not flagged)
R07 decisive unknowns block a PASS

R38 (2026-09-30) outside-region points are attributed ONLY by MEASURED member geometry (fail-closed); a declarative-only record attributes nothing; PARTIAL declared coverage cannot buy a PASS and the residual is reported; a ROI marked invalid is refused
R04/R05 time tolerance, union-of-intervals coverage, full-window denominator, declared frame chain applied or BLOCKED
R12 strict (same estimand, independent arithmetic) vs sensitivity mode, measured tolerance
known-contract cases PASS (2 cm normal offset, tangential slip, SE3 with sourced transform) and FAIL correctly (6 cm normal offset, sparse blunder)
steps.failure_means: the submitted tool does not implement the contract as documented; do NOT proceed to the offline recompute
steps.mid_flight_rule: run the WHOLE modules, never a hand-picked single case

steps.name: offline recompute over the EXISTING diagnosis artifacts (no replay)
steps.expected: two JSONs in evaluation/results/: replay_1_upstream and replay_2_fork. Both must be status=DIAGNOSTIC_ONLY_ROI with pass=null (the ROI available today is diagnostic-only) and diagnostic_would_be_status reflecting a frame/coverage problem, NOT an accuracy verdict. Runtime ~2-4 min total at --stat-voxel 0.25.
covers: the legacy eval_map.py 'accuracy_measurable=true' verdict is not reproducible under the corrected contract
frame misalignment is visible as near-zero support coverage, which the legacy report never recorded
steps.not_covered: no accuracy PASS/FAIL may be produced for the baseline: the pre-defined ROI and the sourced coordinate chain are still missing (see blockers)

steps.name: strict cross-check on a real artifact pair
steps.expected: status=MEASURED on the SAME denominator as the main result; comparison.agrees reported against a MEASURED tolerance (3 x across-fold SE). Runtime ~2 min.
covers: arithmetic independence of the main implementation on real data

steps.name: CLI smoke of both tools on synthetic files

must_not_run: any online front-end, bag playback, short test or full replay (budget 0)
any build / lint / project-wide test suite
any modification of the legacy evaluators or of the algorithm/config

determinism.seeds: every sampler and jitter is seeded; results are bit-reproducible for a fixed voxel/origin/seed
determinism.known_nondeterminism: cKDTree workers=-1 is thread-parallel; the reduction is exact per query (nearest neighbour) so results are stable, but per-fold values can differ in the last ulp on different core counts

blockers_that_no_verification_can_remove: no pre-defined, observation-conditioned support ROI exists in the historical inputs -> the main metric is BLOCKED (NOT_MEASURABLE / BLOCKED_PREDEFINED_ROI_MISSING); owner: DatasetQualification

no independent-source coordinate chain (source->target transform + lever arm provenance) exists for the baseline -> BLOCKED; the legacy reference-frame relation is itself under revision (EvidenceAudit frame_consistency v2)
no TF-consumer rule (hold validity / association tolerance / gap limit) was recorded for the historical runs -> the online availability rate is BLOCKED
acceptance_of_this_plan: the plan is satisfied when V1 is green, V2/V3/V4 reproduce the expected statuses, and NO accuracy PASS/FAIL is emitted for the baseline while the blockers above stand
